prompt: In the style of the typical art style of the Dungeons & Dragons books — high quality, high fidelity, clear digitally painted images, generate an image based on this description: Matyas, a broad and muscular sand-skinned human paladin with long white hair and striking red eyes, lies on the lush jungle floor of Chult, having just woken up. He is propped up slightly on one elbow, his white hair splayed across the mossy ground around him. His expression is one of drowsy, wide-eyed curiosity and quiet wonder, with a drop of fright. Around him, several Chwingas — tiny, black, mask-faced nature spirits no taller than a hand — have swarmed him with fascination. Two or three are clutching and tugging at his long white hair with their small dark hands, thoroughly captivated by it. One leans in extremely close to his face, its simple white carved mask nearly touching his nose, staring intently at his unusual red eyes. Another peeks out from behind his pauldron. They move with the slow deliberate care of creatures deciding whether to trust, but clearly too curious to stay away. The setting is a lush, misty jungle floor — thick broad leaves, pale glowing blooms, gnarled roots, and soft filtered light filtering down through the dense Chultan canopy above. The mood is quiet, tender, and magical — a big armored man caught off guard by something tiny and wonderful.
